components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 52px; padding: 0 22px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid transparent; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); font-weight: 550; font-size: 0.98rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color .35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color .35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow .5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; transition: transform .45s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-live { background: var(--live, #e60039); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -8px rgb(230 0 57 / .55), inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / .18); } .ds-btn-live:hover { background: #ff0a47; box-shadow: 0 16px 44px -10px rgb(230 0 57 / .75), inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / .22); } .ds-btn-live:hover svg { transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--live, #e60039); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-field span { font-size: .88rem; color: var(--dim, #a6a6a6); } .ds-field input { padding: 14px; font: inherit; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--ink, #fafafa); background: var(--surface, #1f1f1f); border: 1px solid var(--line, #333); border-radius: 4px; transition: border-color .3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow .3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #4a4a4a; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ink, #fafafa); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(230 0 57 / .4); }

components.css: .ds-topbar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; padding: 16px 32px; background: rgb(20 20 20 / .72); backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.2); border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(51 51 51 / .6); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--ink, #fafafa); } .ds-wordmark { font-weight: 620; font-size: 1.02rem; letter-spacing: -.025em; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-topnav { display: flex; gap: 30px; font-size: .93rem; } .ds-topnav a { color: var(--dim, #a6a6a6); text-decoration: none; transition: color .3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-topnav a:hover { color: var(--ink, #fafafa); } .ds-lang { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #333); border-radius: 4px; } .ds-lang-opt { border: 0; background: none; padding: 6px 10px; font: inherit; font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 550; letter-spacing: .02em; color: var(--dim, #a6a6a6); border-radius: 3px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-lang-opt.is-on { background: var(--line, #333); color: var(--ink, #fafafa); } .ds-lang-opt:focus-visible, .ds-topnav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--live, #e60039); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Project Index Row

components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.7fr 1fr 1.35fr; gap: 24px; align-items: center; padding: 24px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #333); color: var(--ink, #fafafa); text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-row-name { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 18px; font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 560; letter-spacing: -.03em; line-height: 1.15; transition: transform .6s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-row:hover .ds-row-name, .ds-row:focus-visible .ds-row-name { transform: translateX(10px); } .ds-mono { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: .8125rem; letter-spacing: .01em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-dim { color: var(--dim, #a6a6a6); } .ds-cat { color: #d4d4d4; } .ds-domain { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 10px; } .ds-domain svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; color: var(--ink, #fafafa); transition: transform .5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color .3s; } .ds-row:hover .ds-domain svg { color: var(--live, #e60039); transform: translate(2px,-2px); } .ds-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--live, #e60039); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--live, #e60039); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Live Indicator
components.description: 7px crimson dot with a pinging ring; marks a project as live.
components.css: .ds-live { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: var(--font-mono, 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: .8125rem; color: var(--dim, #a6a6a6); } .ds-live-dot { position: relative; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--live, #e60039); } .ds-live-dot::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -4px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid var(--live, #e60039); animation: ds-ping 2.4s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-ping { 0% { transform: scale(.4); opacity: .9; } 70%, 100% { transform: scale(1.6); opacity: 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-live-dot::after { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Every client site is launched like a product at a keynote: alone on a dark stage, under one light, revealed in builds. The house is a charcoal stage: a solid floor and a slightly lifted air, lit by warm white spot cones falling from top center. There are no cards, no grids of thumbnails, no skill bars. Each section is a keynote ritual (the opening slide, the statement slide, the product reveal, the spec sheet, the presenter, "one more thing"), and each carries one statement at slide scale.

The palette is owner-pinned (21st.dev "Slate Dark") and nearly achromatic. The only chroma on the stage is crimson, and it means one of two things: this is live, or press this. Density is low; one idea per viewport, generous vertical air measured in viewport heights, and hairline rules instead of containers. Motion is damped and theatrical: lights come up, words build in from below a mask, the machine rises and turns. Nothing snaps.

The 3D stage (a single MacBook under a spot, lid scrubbed by scroll, the project scrolling itself on screen) is the signature and sits fixed behind the content. After the machine leaves, everything else sits on the solid stage floor, and later scenes reuse the same light as painted spot cones.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal stage, one warm white spot, film grain over the whole house.
Crimson reserved for live state and primary action.
Slide-scale Geist, tight negative tracking, built word by word.
Geist Mono only for spec data.
Hairline rules and 4px corners; no cards.
Damped motion throughout (Lenis inertia, expo-out builds).

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: Crimson means "live" or "act" and nothing else. It is never decoration, never a heading color, never a background panel. If a crimson element is neither a live indicator nor an action (or that action's hover/focus feedback), it is wrong.

rules.name: The Charcoal Ramp Rule
rules.body: Depth on the page comes from the neutral ramp (floor, air, surface, line), not from new hues. No blue-grays, no warm browns.

rules.name: The Spec Data Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is for data only: counts, indices, categories, places, domains. Never for headings, prose, or decorative labels above headings.

rules.name: The Slide Scale Rule
rules.body: Headings are 600 weight with -0.04em tracking and sub-1 line height, balanced with `text-wrap: balance`. One heading statement per viewport.

rules.name: The One Spot Rule
rules.body: Light falls from above, center, warm white. A scene gets one spot, never a wash or a colored gradient background.

rules.name: The Frosted Bar Rule
rules.body: The only translucent surface is the top bar once scrolled: floor color at 72% with a 14px blur and a hairline under it.

dos: Do keep crimson (#e60039) for live indicators and actions, including their hover and focus feedback.
Do separate content with 1px hairline rules in #333333 instead of boxing it.
Do set headings in Geist at 600 with -0.04em tracking and let one statement own the viewport.
Do put counts, indices, categories, places and domains in Geist Mono at 0.8125rem with tabular numerals.
Do light a scene with a single warm white spot from top center (3D or painted radial gradient).
Do build text in with masked word rises and damped easing; respect reduced motion.
Do use 4px corners on every interactive element.
donts: Don't use cards, thumbnail grids, or skill bars.
Don't use crimson as a decorative accent, heading color, or background panel.
Don't use Poppins or Playfair; the theme's bundled faces were deliberately set aside for Geist.
Don't put Geist Mono on headings, prose, or labels stacked above headings.
Don't add interface hues outside the pinned Slate Dark palette (the MacBook's aluminium and glass are material, not interface color).
Don't snap: no instant jumps, no linear easing on reveals.

knownGaps: Hero floor-pool edge is not visible in the first viewport.
Closed lid blows out under the spot during turns.
About portrait is a framed rectangular photo pending a real alpha cut-out asset.
